label: prf:categorical-fourier-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical Fourier transform
html:
The proof strategy is constructive. We explicitly form the operator \mathcal{F}[f](\xi) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\exp_q(i \xi \cdot) \cdot f) using the categorical trace and the quantum exponential. We then verify that this explicit construction satisfies the monoidal functor properties required for the categorical Fourier transform.

Identical to (existence of categorical Laplace transform) with the substitution s \mapsto -i\xi: the grouplike \exp_q(i\xi\cdot) exists for every categorical spectrum value \xi \in \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, A^\vee), and pairing against the Markov trace yields a well-defined monoidal functor. Equivalently, \mathcal{F}[f](\xi) = \mathcal{L}[f](-i\xi) (Wick rotation) inherits existence from the Laplace case.
